_comment: Simulated upstream commit events for the demo. Paths are upstream-repo-relative (no build prefix) - matching them against the capture's prefixed paths is the relevance filter's job. The commit hash is the unit of selection and triage: a commit is selected iff at least one changed file is in scope, and all in-scope files of a commit are evaluated together under a single verdict.

events.scenario: Quiet security fix touching two in-scope files in one commit (evaluated together)
Real fix in a wireless driver the GW-7100 never builds - no in-scope files, commit not selected (suppressed before triage)
events.message: wifi: ath11k: validate management frame length before parse

events.scenario: Ambiguous pointer-handling change in an in-scope kernel file - needs human review
Routine refactor in an in-scope file - not meaningful
events.message: zutil: convert K&R declarations to ANSI prototypes
